description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

ESChat is hiring a Junior Frontend Software Engineer to develop its web client for its broadband Push-to-Talk product line. The role focuses on building and testing frontend applications, maintaining real-time client-server connections, and contributing to related APIs and backend services.
Junior Front End Software Engineer building Vue.js interfaces, Python/PHP web APIs, and secure WebSocket features; testing responsive applications

Responsibilities:
• Collaborate effectively with team members: Internal customers, designers, and developers to ensure the effectiveness and quality of the design solution
• Write standards compliant frontend code for websites, web applications, and mobile solutions using Vue.js, HTML, CSS and TypeScript
• Use TypeScript to tie client side functionality together, and also make server calls
• Use secure WebSocket’s to maintain real-time connections between client and server
• Develop and maintain back-end services (Python, PHP, MySQL) exposed via web APIs
• Test the frontend code for supported browsers and devices
• Perform system level integration testing through your frontend
• Provide recommendations for technical enhancements and architectural updates to support customer requirements
• Maintain and develop automated tests for APIs and websites
• Create responsive layouts using media queries and other tags. At times, you'll use your own judgment as to how best to alter the layout to accommodate the device width
• Evaluate and improve the UI and code for usability, readability, and performance

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field is required
• 1-3 years of relevant experience
• Project or job-related skill in HTML and CSS
• Project or job-related skill in JavaScript and/or Typescript
• In depth experience in any programming language
• Experience with revision control systems (e.g. GIT, etc)
• Experience with Linux and Windows
• Employment eligibility to work in the U.S. is required. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role now or in the future

Preferred:
• Familiarity with templating tools is a plus
• Familiarity with Vue.js is a plus
• Familiarity with SQL and/or NoSQL is a plus
• Experience with test automation tools (e.g. Selenium, Postman, etc.)
• Experience with Defect tracking systems (e.g. Bugzilla, JIRA, etc.)
